title: Subsetting Data Frames
instructions: Using the `employees` data frame, select only employees older than 30 and print their names and salaries.
starterCode:
employees <- data.frame(
  name = c("Alice", "Bob", "Carol"),
  age = c(28, 35, 42),
  salary = c(50000, 65000, 72000)
)
# Select employees older than 30
subset_df <- employees[___, ___]
print(subset_df)
